how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-dustwallow-marsh-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1287:obj:0: Speak with Captain Garran Vimes in ⟦E1⟧ about Reethe.
rows.quest:1287:details:1: BWe threw him out of camp because he insisted on raiding the supplies of the ogres up at Brackenwall Village. We're not so many in number that we could stand up to those mindless brutes.
rows.quest:1287:details:2: BHe crossed the line one too many times, so we left him to fend for himself.
rows.quest:1287:details:3: BNow, I helped you out... So, why don't you help us out and forget you bumped into us?
rows.quest:1287:completion:0: I will send Lieutenant Caldwell to deal with the deserters at Lost Point. In addition, I will instruct him to find Reethe. The marsh is not so big and trackless that he should be unable to find him.
rows.quest:1319:obj:0: Show the Blackened Iron Shield to Caz Twosprocket in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1319:details:0: I'm sorry I can't be of much help, ⟦1⟧, but I can refer you to someone who would be. Caz Twosprocket, one of our best blacksmiths, works the forge at the smithy.
rows.quest:1319:details:1: BTake the shield to him, and see what he can tell you.
rows.quest:1319:completion:0: Hm... interesting piece of iron you have here. Definitely not made by any of the blacksmiths I know over on this side of the sea, and it's certainly not my work.
rows.quest:1320:obj:0: Speak with Captain Garran Vimes in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1320:details:0: Ah, I almost missed this... The leather strap on the back must have burned off, but it seems like it was made to fit a large person. I'd guess a tauren, actually.
rows.quest:1320:details:1: BThat's about all I can tell you. Tell Captain Vimes I'm sorry I couldn't be of more help.
rows.quest:1320:completion:0: That's not much information to work on, but we'll have to keep it in mind. Hopefully some of the other pieces of this mystery will fall into place, and paint a more helpful picture of what happened.
rows.quest:1321:obj:0: Show the Blackened Iron Shield to Do'gol in Brackenwall Village.
rows.quest:1321:details:0: Hmm... I don't see anything out of the ordinary with this shield. We should have Do'gol, the blacksmith, take a look at it, and see if he can tell us more about it, but I wouldn't hold out hope...
rows.quest:1321:completion:0: This is good shield. Very strong, heavy, good. But Do'gol don't need it. I make shields, not buy them, ⟦2⟧.
rows.quest:1322:obj:0: Acquire 5 Acidic Venom Sacs for Do'gol in Brackenwall Village.
rows.quest:1322:details:0: Hmmm, there's writing right here on the rim of the shield, but it's hard to read from all the burned stuff.
rows.quest:1322:details:1: BI need acid to make it clear. Venom from the darkmist spiders would do good. The spiders have taken over an old mine, the Darkmist Cavern, northwest of the village. Get me some of their sacs and I can clean this up.
rows.quest:1322:completion:0: I don't like spiders that are so big I can't sit on them and squish them.
rows.quest:1322:completion:1: BThanks for getting them, ⟦3⟧. Now I rip them open and pour them onto the shield...
rows.quest:1323:obj:0: Talk with Krog in Brackenwall Village.
rows.quest:1323:details:0: Oh, I think I might have dropped too much acid onto the shield. Let me just rub a little...
rows.quest:1323:details:1: BHm, kind of hard to read, but it looks like the name Mosarn. Never heard of him. Maybe Krog knows. Krog knows many people.
rows.quest:1323:completion:0: Mosarn? Sounds familiar... I can't put my finger on it. Maybe it'll come to me later.
rows.quest:1323:completion:1: BIt probably isn't important. A shield can come from anywhere and not mean anything...
rows.quest:6570:obj:0: ⟦E2⟧ to the Wyrmbog in ⟦E3⟧ and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.⟦4⟧
rows.quest:6570:details:0: I have attuned this medallion with the magic necessary to create and maintain an illusion within the bounds of the den of Emberstrife.
rows.quest:6570:details:1: BEmberstrife is an ancient drake; an old gatekeeper of ⟦E4⟧, burdened with the duty to test those dragonspawn that would ascend to the rank of elite guard to ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:6570:details:2: BTravel to the Wyrmbog of ⟦E3⟧ and enter the lair of Emberstrife. Once there, put on the amulet and follow where your destiny may lead!⟦5⟧
rows.quest:6570:completion:0: Have we run so low on able soldiers that ⟦E4⟧ is sending me whelps? You will never pass my tests, broodling.
rows.quest:6582:obj:0: You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse and return it to Emberstrife.
rows.quest:6582:obj:1: BYou know that Scryer can be found in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:6582:details:0: We are ⟦E7⟧'s children, whelp. Our dominance over the lesser Aspects must be enforced.
rows.quest:6582:details:1: BIf you are truly worthy of ascension, the lesser dragonflight will wilt in your presence.
rows.quest:6582:details:2: BFind their champions and lay waste to them in the name of our Father!
rows.quest:6582:details:3: BTravel to ⟦E6⟧ and track down the mighty blue drake, Scryer. Crush him and any of the Blue Flight that stand in your path. Tear out his skull and return it to me.
rows.quest:6583:obj:0: Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus. Take his skull and return it to Emberstrife.
rows.quest:6583:details:0: Just as our Father crushes the Aspects themselves, so too must we strive to bring chaos and destruction to their children.
rows.quest:6583:details:1: BYou must test your battle prowess against the sleepless dreamers: The children of the Green Flight.
rows.quest:6583:details:2: BTravel to the ⟦E8⟧ and track down Somnus, drake champion of the Green Flight. Let flow your hatred; dominate the insect... Return to me with his skull...
rows.quest:6584:obj:0: Guarding the Caverns of Time in the ⟦E9⟧ Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.
rows.quest:6584:details:0: The time watchers, children of Nozdormu - Lord of the Centuriesss...
rows.quest:6584:details:1: BIt is three that guard the Caverns of Time, but only one that holds the interests of the Black Flight: The Time Shifter, Chronalis, favored drakeling of Nozdormu.
rows.quest:6584:details:2: BSsstrike at this champion, a blow to make even the stoic sands of time weep. Return to me with his skull.
rows.quest:6585:obj:0: ⟦E2⟧ to Grim Batol and track down Axtroz, drake champion of the Red Flight. Destroy him and take his skull. Return the skull to Emberstrife.
rows.quest:6585:details:0: It was over the mountains of Grim Batol that our Father raged against the combined might of the Aspects. The cowardly act of the betrayer, Alexstrasza, bought the other Aspects enough time to escape from Father's wrath.
rows.quest:6585:details:2: BThe Red Flight now guards Grim Batol, their lieutenant, Axtroz, must be destroyed. Return the skull of Axtroz to me. For Father, whelp!
rows.quest:6585:completion:0: I had doubted your dedication, whelp. You persisted, dominating our enemies, bringing honor to our flight.
rows.quest:6585:completion:1: BI must now prepare the skulls for your ascension.
rows.quest:6601:obj:0: It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rexxar and explain your predicament. Show him the Dull Drakefire Amulet. Hopefully he will know what to do next.
rows.quest:6601:details:0: From the skulls of our enemies is shaped a medallion. You know this medallion, yesss? You have no doubt seen it worn by your elders.
rows.quest:6601:details:1: BTake it, whelp. Return to the Spire and present it to General Drakkisath. The General will place the final enchantment upon the medallion, attuning the trinket to your spirit.
rows.quest:6601:details:2: BYou will wear the finished medallion as a badge of honor, symbolizing your ascension to one of our most guarded ranks: Guardian to the brood mother.
rows.quest:6601:completion:0: It is merely dragon-talk, ⟦6⟧ - more hot air than actual substantive information. Pompous, aggressive behavior is to be expected from their kind.
rows.quest:7541:completion:0: It will take time for our scholars to study the pendant you brought us. But for your service to the ⟦E10⟧ I would like to offer you a small token.
rows.quest:7541:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦7⟧. Your acts bring honor to you, and to us.
